evidence: The Alternative.me Fear & Greed Index recorded a score of 7 ('Extreme Fear') heading into June 16, continuing a multi-day slide from 8 and 11, with the 7-day average depressed at 10.86. Although deeply depressed sentiment readings historically present mean-reversion and relief-bounce opportunities, protracted single-digit sentiment often reflects active market capitulation and forced selling where downward trend momentum dominates over a short 24-hour window. Consequently, the probability of BTC closing strictly higher is modestly sub-50%.
